audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[N].side disagreed with content win[N] on every row; win[N] matches the packet levelChart.
audit.why: Vladimir has no Sanguine Pool at level 1, so that row is Ekko's; levels 2-3 are the pool-baiting skill window; from 4 on Ekko's stun-into-burst outpaces sustain.
audit.corrected: Full sides set to Ekko/Skill/Skill/Ekko/Ekko/Ekko/Ekko with ratings and whys rewritten to match.

audit.why: Hemoplague is a flat 120s at all ranks while Chronobreak is 110/80/50, so Ekko's ult returns faster every rank — the spike text already tracked the right idea and now carries the numbers.
audit.corrected: Level 6 why now names the 120s flat cooldown as the fight window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing stated that Sanguine Pool is 2 seconds of untargetability on a 28s rank-1 cooldown, or that Grievous Wounds decides the extended trade.
audit.why: Both are in the kit flags and both decide when you may commit.
audit.corrected: Pool duration and cooldown added to breakdown.cooldowns; anti-heal timing folded into breakdown.carry and the first-item spike.

audit.why: It is the field that holds real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Sanguine Pool 28s->16s, Transfusion 9s->4.6s, Hemoplague 120s flat, Chronobreak 110s rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d duplicated tradeGood and dontsFull[2].d duplicated tradeBad (lint: COPY_PASTE_BLEED x2).
audit.why: The bodies did not answer their titles.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten against their own titles using Phase Dive and Chronobreak cooldowns.

edits.after: Ekko

edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. It governs your forward steps. - R Chronobreak spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Sanguine Pool: 28s at rank 1, down to 16s at rank 5 — two seconds untargetable, so bait it before you spend the W stun. - Transfusion: 9s at rank 1 and 4.6s at rank 5, all his sustain. - Hemoplague: 120s flat and Chronobreak is 110s at rank 1 — fight on that gap.

edits.before: Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Timewinder chips a second time on the return pass — land both passes while he steps to 600 range for Transfusion.

edits.before: Q through him, E the gap, passive third hit, walk out through the slow — the full string chunks and the return pass pays the exit.
edits.after: Phase Dive is 325 range and 9s at rank 1 — it is your only way in and back out, so never step up while it is down.

edits.before: Vladimir spends Sanguine Pool early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Chronobreak heals off the damage taken in the rewind window — commit, then undo the cost.

edits.before: That’s Vladimir’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Sanguine Pool eats your E-W burst and leaves you standing in Tides of Blood.

edits.before: The rewind heals off the hologram's path — diving away from your own past is how Ekkos die with R up.
edits.after: Transfusion costs him nothing and heals at 600 range — chip trades there refund him and cost you.

edits.before: Blinking in with R down against a loaded kit — Ekko without the rewind is a mid laner doing parkour at a funeral.
edits.after: Chronobreak is 110s at rank 1 and 50s at rank 3 — hoarding it wastes the insurance that makes your dives safe.

edits.before: Vladimir wins by landing Sanguine Pool, denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Vladimir wins by pooling your stun, healing the chip back with Transfusion, and amping the fight with Hemoplague.

edits.before: Carry through insured dives — one carry per rewind cycle; your job is spending R as a weapon, not an apology.
edits.after: Carry with anti-heal and timing — buy Grievous Wounds early, bait the 28s pool, then dive the moment it is spent.

edits.before: Ekko's burst combo starts overwhelming Vladimir's sustain, since his healing can't keep pace with a full Q-W-R burst sequence landing back to back.
edits.after: Ekko's burst overwhelms Vladimir's sustain once Grievous Wounds is on the bill — Transfusion and Hemoplague healing cannot keep pace with a full Q-W-R string.
